title: Schedule a flight for a future date
why: Checks that far-future scheduling is allowed and that departure before arrival with Status Unknown is accepted.

steps.does: POST …/flight with FlightNumber FL-4001, FlightDate 2026-11-22 (30 days ahead), DepartureDate 2026-11-22T09:00, ArriveDate 2026-11-22T10:00, DurationMinutes 60, Price 8, Status Unknown

expect: Success: flight stored with Status Unknown and DepartureDate earlier than ArriveDate.
